title: study vlog | getting my life together after a slump 😵‍💫☕ study grind is back (barely) 📖
description:
🌸 ep. 22 🌸 hi you lovely people 

This schedule actually took me out this time. But I am feeling so much better mindset wise tbh. Not exactly sure what I did specifically to feel this way but I would say it was probably sticking to a routine and being productive even when there are so many other things I could have been doing. Although I was genuinely EXHAUSTED after those two days, I feel all the more better for it :)

Will be studying a bit more intensely in the next few uploads to come (my anatomy lab exam awaits me) x

As always,

thank you for being here ♡
